blocks.text: ARG exists only during the build (from its declaration onward in that stage); ENV is stored in the image config and present in every container.

rows: Values used in RUN show in docker history

blocks.code:
ARG PYTHON_VERSION=3.12                 # before FROM: only usable in FROM lines
FROM python:${PYTHON_VERSION}-slim-bookworm
ARG PYTHON_VERSION                      # redeclare to use inside the stage
ARG APP_VERSION=dev
ENV APP_VERSION=${APP_VERSION}          # promote to runtime

items: Each stage has its own ARG scope.
Proxy args are predefined and excluded from history.

blocks.text: Neither is for secrets: `--build-arg TOKEN` used in RUN appears in history; ENV ships in the config to everyone who pulls. Use BuildKit secret mounts and runtime injection.

Q: "ARG vs ENV?" A: "ARG is a build-time variable, gone at runtime but visible in history if used in RUN; ENV persists in the image and the container. Pre-FROM ARGs only work in FROM lines, and neither should ever carry a secret."

items: Put the venv on PATH via ENV.
